title: One step from an active state
statement: Let $w$ be a finite input word, and consider a configuration of a three-work-tape Turing machine whose state is an active state $q$, whose input-head position is $p$, whose work tapes are $T_0,T_1,T_2$, whose work-head positions are $h_0,h_1,h_2$, and whose output word is $o$. The machine’s next configuration is the result of applying to this configuration the action prescribed by its transition function at state $q$, reading the symbol under the input head and the symbols under the three work-tape heads.
hypotheses_covered: Input word $w$ is a finite Boolean word.
The configuration has an active state $q$.
Input-head position $p$ is among the valid positions for $w$.
There are three work tapes $T_i$ and three work-head positions $h_i$.
The output is a finite Boolean word $o$.
